description.text: 用一两句话写完一张小纸条，直接回答或说明即可。
Finish a small note in one or two sentences. Just answer or say what it is.

usageDescription.text: 题目问什么就写什么，一两句答完即可。
Write the answer in one or two sentences. Do not add extra setup.
写清这是什么、写给谁看，不用铺垫。
Say what this is and who it is for. Do not warm up.

description.text: 用一两个词或一句话写清这是谁的、这是什么。
Use a word or one sentence to say whose it is or what it is.

usageDescription.text: 题目问这是谁的，就写名字或所属。
If the prompt asks whose it is, write the name.
用一句话写清这件物品或这个位置是什么。
Say in one sentence what this item or place is.

description.text: 按空填写姓名、日期或一句短答。
Fill in a name, a date, or a short answer in the blank.

usageDescription.text: 空里问什么就填什么，不要另起一段。
Write only what the blank asks for.
按表格这一格的提示写短句。
Follow the box prompt and write a short line.

description.text: 只写图上有什么。一篇一段，只有起。
Say what is in the picture. One paragraph, opening only.

usageName.text: Say what is in the picture

usageDescription.text: 点出图上是谁或什么，让人知道这段在写这幅图。
Name who or what is in the picture.
题目问图上什么，这一句就答。
Answer the question about the picture.

name.text: A Few Sentences from a Picture

description.text: 先写图上有什么，再补一点看到的细节。
First write what is in the picture, then add a little more that you can see.

usageName.text: Say what is in the picture

usageDescription.text: 先点出图上是谁或什么，让人知道这段在写这幅图。
First name who or what is in the picture.
题目问图上什么，第一句就答。
Answer the question about the picture in the first sentence.
再写颜色、位置或在做什么。
Add color, place, or what they are doing.
按图上能看出的先后写下去。
Tell what happens in the order the picture shows.

description.text: 先点出这幅图写什么，再按图上的顺序写下去，最后可以写一句感受。
First say what the picture is about, then follow its order, and you may end with a feeling.

usageName.text: Say what the picture is about

usageDescription.text: 先说这幅图在写谁或什么事。
First say who or what this picture is about.
跟着图上的先后把经过写下去。
Follow the order in the picture and tell what happens.
写一句你看完图的感受或判断。
End with how you feel or what you think about the picture.
用一句把图上的样子或气氛收住。
Close with one more look at how the picture appears.

description.text: 看着图画把经过写完整，也可以写图中的原因，最后写出你的感受或判断。
Tell the events from the picture, add a reason if the picture shows one, and end with how you feel or what you think.

usageDescription.text: 先写图上是谁、在什么地方。
First say who is in the picture and where they are.
从图上最先发生的那一下写起。
Start with the first thing the picture shows happening.
按顺序把图上能看到的经过写完。
Tell the events from the picture in order, and finish them.

usageName.text: Give the reason in the picture

usageDescription.text: 如果图里能看出为什么，就写在这里。
If the picture shows why, write that reason here.

usageName.text: End with a feeling or judgment

usageDescription.text: 写你看完以后的感受，或你觉得怎样。
End with how you feel or what you think after seeing it.

description.text: 先说这是谁或什么，再补上几句细节。
First say who or what it is, then add a few details.

usageDescription.text: 第一句点出你要介绍的人、地方或东西。
Name the person, place, or thing in the first sentence.
再写几句它长什么样、常做什么。
Add a few sentences about how it looks or what it is like.

description.text: 先介绍对象，再多写几句它的特点，也可以比一比，最后收一句感受。
Introduce the person or thing, add more about it, compare if it helps, and end with a feeling.

usageDescription.text: 先说这是谁或什么，让人知道你在介绍什么。
First say who or what you are introducing.
把样子、爱好或特别的地方写充分。
Add enough about how it looks, what it likes, or what is special.
拿它跟另一个人、地方或东西比一处。
Compare it with one other person, place, or thing.
写一个原因或例子，说明它为什么值得介绍。
Give a reason or example for why it is worth introducing.
用一句你的喜好或评价收住。
Close with what you like or how you see it.
用一句把它整体是什么样收住。
Close with one sentence about the overall impression.

headDescription.text: 先写给谁，比如 Hi Tom 或 Dear Sir or Madam。
Write who it is for, such as Hi Tom or Dear Sir or Madam.

tailDescription.text: 最后写落款，比如 Yours, 或 Yours faithfully。
End with a sign-off, such as Yours, or Yours faithfully.

description.text: 先写你为什么写信，再写一句收尾。别忘了称呼和落款。
First say why you are writing, then add a short close. Remember the greeting and sign-off.

usageDescription.text: 题目里问什么就先答什么，再补一句相关细节。
Answer what the prompt asks first, then add one related detail.
先写你为什么写信、要说哪一件事。
First say why you are writing and what it is about.
用一句把信收住，比如谢谢或回见。
Close the mail in one sentence, such as a thank-you or see you.

headDescription.text: 先写给谁，比如 Hi Tom 或 Dear Sir or Madam。
Write who it is for, such as Hi Tom or Dear Sir or Madam.

tailDescription.text: 最后写落款，比如 Yours, 或 Yours faithfully。
End with a sign-off, such as Yours, or Yours faithfully.

description.text: 先说来意，再把事情写清楚，最后礼貌收尾。
First say why you are writing, then explain the matter, and close politely.

usageDescription.text: 先写你为什么写信，让对方知道来意。
First say why you are writing, so the reader knows your purpose.
把时间、地点或要对方知道的事写明白。
Write the time, place, or facts the reader needs to know.
补上为什么，或举一件具体的事。
Add why, or give one concrete example.

usageName.text: Write the problem and a way

usageDescription.text: 写你碰到什么麻烦，需要对方怎样帮忙。
Say what the trouble is and what help you need.
用一句谢谢、回见或等回复把信收住。
Close with thanks, see you, or that you wait for a reply.
写一句你希望对方怎样，或你的看法。
Add what you hope they will do, or what you think.

headDescription.text: 先写给谁，比如 Hi Tom 或 Dear Sir or Madam。
Write who it is for, such as Hi Tom or Dear Sir or Madam.

tailDescription.text: 最后写落款，比如 Yours, 或 Yours faithfully。
End with a sign-off, such as Yours, or Yours faithfully.

description.text: 先说来意，再把事情写充分，需要时提出请求，最后礼貌收尾。
First say why you are writing, explain the matter, make a request if you need to, and close politely.

usageDescription.text: 先写你为什么写信，把来意说清楚。
First say why you are writing and make your purpose clear.
把事情的原因或依据写够，让对方看得懂。
Give enough reasons or facts so the reader can follow.
如果要说明怎么做、怎么安排，按步骤写。
If you need to say how it works or how it is arranged, write the steps.
把这件事本身写清楚：是什么、有谁、在哪。
Explain the matter itself: what it is, who is involved, and where.
在这里提出你希望对方做什么，或你的看法。
Ask the reader to do something, or give your view.
如果还有麻烦要对方处理，写在这里。
If a problem still needs the reader, write it here.
礼貌收尾，可以再提一句你希望怎样。
Close politely, and you may add one hope.
用一句谢谢、回见或等回复收住。
Close with thanks, see you, or that you wait for a reply.

headDescription.text: 先写称呼，比如 Dear Tom 或 Dear Sir or Madam。
Write who it is for, such as Dear Tom or Dear Sir or Madam.

tailDescription.text: 最后写落款，比如 Yours, 或 Yours sincerely。
End with a sign-off, such as Yours, or Yours sincerely.

description.text: 先写称呼，说来意，把事情写清楚，最后落款。
Write a greeting, say why you are writing, make the matter clear, and sign off.

usageDescription.text: 先写你为什么写信，让对方知道来意。
First say why you are writing, so the reader knows your purpose.
把时间、地点或要对方知道的事写明白。
Write the time, place, or facts the reader needs to know.
补上为什么，或举一件具体的事。
Add why, or give one concrete example.

usageName.text: Write the problem and a way

usageDescription.text: 写你碰到什么麻烦，需要对方怎样帮忙。
Say what the trouble is and what help you need.
用一句谢谢、回见或等回复把信收住。
Close with thanks, see you, or that you wait for a reply.
写一句你希望对方怎样，或你的看法。
Add what you hope they will do, or what you think.

headDescription.text: 可以先写下给谁，比如 Tom,。
You may write who it is for, such as Tom,

tailDescription.text: 最后可以写自己的名字。
You may end with your name.

description.text: 用一两句话留下你要说的事，可以先写下给谁。
Leave one or two sentences for someone. You may write who it is for.

usageDescription.text: 题目里问什么就先答什么，再补一句相关细节。
Answer what the prompt asks first, then add one related detail.
先写你为什么写信、要说哪一件事。
First say why you are writing and what it is about.
用一句把信收住，比如谢谢或回见。
Close the mail in one sentence, such as a thank-you or see you.

headDescription.text: 先写日期，也可以加天气。
Write the date first. You may add the weather.

description.text: 先写下时间和天气，再说你做了什么。
First write the date and weather, then say what you did.

usageDescription.text: 先写这是怎样的一天，或你要写哪一件。
First say what kind of day it was, or which thing you will write about.
按顺序写你做了什么。
Tell what you did, in order.
写你看到的、碰到的，或那天是什么样。
Write what you saw, what happened around you, or what the day was like.

headDescription.text: 先写日期，也可以加天气。
Write the date first. You may add the weather.

description.text: 先写时间和场景，再写当天的经过，最后写下感受。
Write the time and setting, tell what happened that day, and end with how you felt.

usageDescription.text: 先写什么时候、在哪里，让人知道是那一次。
First say when and where, so it is clear this is that one time.
按顺序写下当天发生的事。
Tell what happened that day, in order.
收一句你当天的心情或想法。
End with how you felt or what you thought that day.

headDescription.text: 先写日期，也可以加天气。
Write the date first. You may add the weather.

description.text: 写下那一天的经过，也可以写为什么印象深，最后收住心情。
Write what happened that day, add why it mattered to you, and close with your feeling.

usageDescription.text: 先点出你要写的那一天或那一件。
First name the day or the occasion you will write about.
从那天最先发生的事写起。
Start with the first thing that happened that day.
按顺序把当天的经过写完整。
Tell the events of that day in order.

usageName.text: Say why it stayed with you

usageDescription.text: 写这件事为什么让你记得，或举一个特别的地方。
Say why this stayed with you, or give one special moment.
用一句心情或想法把这一天收住。
Close the day with how you felt or what you thought.

description.text: 先说这是什么，再说明它怎么做，或为什么会这样。
First say what it is, then explain how it works or why it is so.

usageDescription.text: 先点出你要说明的东西或做法。
First name what you are going to explain.
按步骤写它一般怎么做。
Write the usual steps.
写原因，或举一个能看懂的例子。
Give a reason, or one example that makes it clear.
用一句回到你说明的那一件，把它收住。
Close by coming back to the thing you explained.

usageName.text: Add a view or a tip

usageDescription.text: 可以写一句你的看法，或提醒别人注意什么。
You may add what you think, or one thing to watch for.

description.text: 先介绍对象，再写清过程、原因或影响，最后作一个小结。
Introduce the topic, explain the process, reason, or effect, and close with a short summary.

usageDescription.text: 先说你要说明或报告的是什么。
First say what you are explaining or reporting.
用自己的话写出原文在讲什么，不要照抄。
Say the original main point in your own words. Do not copy.
按步骤把过程或做法写清楚。
Write the process or steps clearly.
把为什么、会怎样写充分。
Explain why, or what follows from it.
用自己的话转述原文中间的要点。
Retell the middle points of the original in your own words.
补一个更关键的原因、影响或例外。
Add one more important reason, effect, or exception.

usageName.text: Write a problem and a response

usageDescription.text: 如果要写困难和办法，写在这里。
If you need a difficulty and a way to deal with it, write it here.
用一句判断或结论把说明收住。
Close with a short judgment or conclusion.
回到你说明的那一件，用一句收住。
Come back to the subject and close it in one sentence.
用自己的话把原文的收束转述出来。
Retell the original closing point in your own words.

description.text: 先写标题和对象，再写清过程、原因或结果，最后作一个小结。
Start with a title and the topic, explain the process, reason, or result, and close with a short summary.

usageDescription.text: 先说你要说明或报告的是什么。
First say what you are explaining or reporting.
用自己的话写出原文在讲什么，不要照抄。
Say the original main point in your own words. Do not copy.
按步骤把过程或做法写清楚。
Write the process or steps clearly.
把为什么、会怎样写充分。
Explain why, or what follows from it.
用自己的话转述原文中间的要点。
Retell the middle points of the original in your own words.
补一个更关键的原因、影响或例外。
Add one more important reason, effect, or exception.

usageName.text: Write a problem and a response

usageDescription.text: 如果要写困难和办法，写在这里。
If you need a difficulty and a way to deal with it, write it here.
用一句判断或结论把说明收住。
Close with a short judgment or conclusion.
回到你说明的那一件，用一句收住。
Come back to the subject and close it in one sentence.
用自己的话把原文的收束转述出来。
Retell the original closing point in your own words.

headDescription.text: 先写标题。发言稿也可以加 Good morning, everyone。
Write a title first. A speech may also add Good morning, everyone.

tailDescription.text: 最后写落款或署名。
End with a sign-off or a name.

description.text: 先说明这是什么通知，再写清时间、地点和对象，最后写欢迎或要求。
First say what the notice is about, then give the time, place, and who it is for, and end with a welcome or a request.

usageDescription.text: 先写这是关于什么活动或事情的通知。
First say what this notice is about.
把何时、何地、给谁看写清楚。
Write when, where, and who it is for.
用一句欢迎参加，或提醒带什么。
Add a welcome, or remind people what to bring.
写你希望大家怎样做。
Say what you hope people will do.

headDescription.text: 先写标题，让人一眼看见这是什么通知。
Write a title first so people can see what this notice is.

tailDescription.text: 最后写落款或署名。
End with a sign-off or a name.

description.text: 先说明这是什么通知，再写清关键信息，需要时说明怎么参加，最后发出要求。
Say what the notice is about, give the key facts, explain how to take part if needed, and end with a request.

usageDescription.text: 先说明这是一次什么通知或发言。
First say what this notice or speech is.
先说你为什么站在这里、要大家注意什么。
First say why you are speaking and what people should notice.
把时间、地点、对象或安排写清楚。
Write the time, place, who it is for, or the plan.
按步骤写怎么报名、怎么到场或怎么做。
Write the steps for how to join, arrive, or take part.
用一句呼吁、邀请或要求收住。
Close with a call, an invitation, or a request.

headDescription.text: 先问好，比如 Good morning, everyone。
Greet the listeners first, such as Good morning, everyone.

tailDescription.text: 最后致谢或发出呼吁。
End with thanks or a call to action.

description.text: 先问好并说来意，再讲清关键信息，最后发出呼吁或致谢。
Greet the listeners and say your purpose, give the key facts, and end with a call or thanks.

usageDescription.text: 先说明这是一次什么通知或发言。
First say what this notice or speech is.
先说你为什么站在这里、要大家注意什么。
First say why you are speaking and what people should notice.
把时间、地点、对象或安排写清楚。
Write the time, place, who it is for, or the plan.
按步骤写怎么报名、怎么到场或怎么做。
Write the steps for how to join, arrive, or take part.
用一句呼吁、邀请或要求收住。
Close with a call, an invitation, or a request.

description.text: 先说出你的看法，再写理由，最后再点一句观点。
State your view, give your reason, and close with your opinion again.

usageDescription.text: 第一句就写出你赞成、反对或觉得怎样。
State your view in the first sentence.
写一两个理由，或举一件能撑住看法的事。
Give one or two reasons, or one example that supports your view.
用一句把观点再点清楚，不要另起话题。
Restate your view. Do not start a new topic.

description.text: 先说出看法，再把理由写充分，也可以比较，最后收住结论。
State your view, develop your reasons, compare if needed, and close with your conclusion.

usageDescription.text: 先写出你的立场或判断。
First state your position or judgment.
先写眼前这个麻烦是什么、谁会碰到。
First say what the trouble is and who meets it.
把理由或例子写够，让看法站得住。
Give enough reasons or examples so the view stands.
拿另一种看法或做法比一处，再回到你的立场。
Compare one other view or way, then come back to yours.
写出可以怎么做，或一个具体办法。
Write what people can do, or one concrete way.
用一句结论把观点收住。
Close with your conclusion.

description.text: 先指出问题或需要，再给出建议和理由，最后收住结论。
Name the problem or need, offer a suggestion with reasons, and close with your conclusion.

usageDescription.text: 先说你建议怎么做，不要只空喊看法。
Say what you suggest people should do.

usageName.text: Name the problem, then the way

usageDescription.text: 先写眼前的问题，再写一条能做的办法。
Name the problem first, then one thing people can do.
把理由或例子写够，让看法站得住。
Give enough reasons or examples so the view stands.
拿另一种看法或做法比一处，再回到你的立场。
Compare one other view or way, then come back to yours.

usageName.text: Name the problem, then the way

usageDescription.text: 先写眼前的问题，再写一条能做的办法。
Name the problem first, then one thing people can do.
先说你建议怎么做，不要只空喊看法。
Say what you suggest people should do.

headDescription.text: 首句或前文已经给定，必须接得上。
The first sentence or earlier text is given and must be continued.

description.text: 接住给出的开头或前文，把情节往下写，经过转折，写到结局。
Pick up the given opening or earlier text, move the story forward, add a turning point, and write the ending.

usageDescription.text: 先接上给出的首句或前文，不要另起一个故事。
Continue from the given first sentence or earlier text. Do not start a new story.
按顺序把接下来发生的事写下去。
Tell what happens next, in order.
写事情发生变化、出乎意料的那一下。
Write the moment things change or go unexpected.
把这件事收到一个结果上。
Bring the events to a result.
可以补一句人物的感受，或这件事留下什么。
You may add how someone felt, or what the events leave behind.

headDescription.text: 首句或前文已经给定，必须接得上。
The first sentence or earlier text is given and must be continued.

description.text: 接住给出的开头，写出接下来发生的事，再给故事一个结尾。
Pick up the given opening, tell what happens next, and give the story an ending.

usageDescription.text: 先接上给出的开头，写下一步发生了什么。
Continue from the given opening and tell what happens next.
如果还有事发生，再按顺序写一步。
If more happens, add one more step in order.
把事情收到一个结果上。
Bring the events to a result.
补一句人物的心情。
Add a line about how the character feels.

headDescription.text: 首句或前文已经给定，必须接得上。
The first sentence or earlier text is given and must be continued.

description.text: 接住给出的开头，把情节往下写，可以加一个小转折，最后写到结局。
Pick up the given opening, move the events forward, add a small twist if you like, and write the ending.

usageDescription.text: 先接上给出的首句或前文，不要另起一个故事。
Continue from the given first sentence or earlier text. Do not start a new story.
按顺序把接下来发生的事写下去。
Tell what happens next, in order.
写事情出现变化的那一下。
Write the moment things change.
把这件事收到一个结果上。
Bring the events to a result.
可以补一句人物的感受，或这件事留下什么。
You may add how someone felt, or what the events leave behind.

description.text: 读完一篇文章，用自己的话把要点写成一段短文，不加自己的看法。
Read a text and retell its main points in your own words as one short paragraph, without adding your own view.

usageName.text: State the main idea and key points

usageDescription.text: 第一句点出原文主旨，接着按原文顺序转述要点。
Open with the main idea of the text, then retell the key points in the original order.
如果要点多，再分一段把剩下的要点写完。
If there are many points, finish the rest in a second paragraph.

headDescription.text: 先写一个醒目的标题，比如 Sports Day a Big Success。
Start with a short headline, such as Sports Day a Big Success.

description.text: 为校报写一篇报道：先用导语交代谁、何时、何地、发生了什么，再写清经过，最后写出意义或反响。
Write a report for the school paper: open with who, when, where and what, tell what happened, and close with why it matters.

usageName.text: 写导语：谁、何时、何地、什么事
Give the lead: who, when, where, what

usageDescription.text: 第一段用一两句把最重要的信息交代清楚。
In one or two sentences, give the most important facts.
按顺序写活动或事件的经过。
Tell how the event unfolded, in order.

usageName.text: 引一句评价或说明意义
Add a quote or why it matters

usageDescription.text: 引用参与者的话，或点出这件事的意义。
Quote someone who took part, or say why the event matters.
写活动的反响、结果或影响。
Close with how people responded, or what the event led to.
用一句话把事件收住。
Wrap up the event in one sentence.

headDescription.text: 正式信写 Dear Sir or Madam，知道姓名时写 Dear Mr Smith。
Use Dear Sir or Madam, or Dear Mr Smith if you know the name.

tailDescription.text: 不知道对方姓名用 Yours faithfully；知道姓名用 Yours sincerely。
Use Yours faithfully if you do not know the name, Yours sincerely if you do.

description.text: 写给不熟的人或机构：先说明写信目的，再把每个要点分段写清，需要时提出请求，最后正式收尾。
Write to someone you do not know well or to an organisation: state your purpose, cover each point in its own paragraph, make your request, and close formally.

usageDescription.text: 第一段说明你是谁、为什么写这封信。
Say who you are and why you are writing.
题目给的每个要点写一段，把情况说具体。
Give each point from the task its own paragraph and make it specific.
说明原因，或把发生的事写具体。
Explain the reasons, or give the details of what happened.
把安排、步骤或做法按顺序写清。
Set out the arrangement or steps in order.

usageName.text: Make a request or propose a fix

usageDescription.text: 说明你希望对方怎么做。
Say what you would like the reader to do.
礼貌地表明你的态度或期待。
Politely state your position or expectation.
说明期待回复，礼貌结束。
Say you look forward to a reply and end politely.
用一句表达希望或感谢。
End with a line of hope or thanks.

description.text: 先说这张图表讲什么，再写出最明显的数据和变化，最后可以用一句话总结。
Say what the chart is about, point out the most obvious figures and changes, and finish with a one-sentence summary if you like.

usageDescription.text: 写清图表的主题、时间和单位。
Give the topic, the time period, and the units.
挑最明显的几个数字写出来。
Pick out the most obvious figures.
把最大和最小的一组放在一起比。
Set the largest and smallest groups side by side.
按时间顺序写升、降和持平。
Describe the rises, falls, and plateaus in time order.
用一句话说出总体特点。
State the overall picture in one sentence.

description.text: 先改写题目说明图表是什么，再写总体特征，然后分段写关键数据和对比，不写自己的看法。
Paraphrase the task to introduce the chart, give an overview of the main trends, then describe key figures and comparisons in detail, with no personal opinion.

usageName.text: 改写题目，说明图表是什么
Introduce the chart in your own words

usageDescription.text: 用自己的话说明图表的主题、时间和单位。
Restate the topic, time period, and units in your own words.
不列数字，只写最主要的趋势或对比。
No figures here; give only the main trends or contrasts.
挑最重要的组别放在一起比，写出具体数字。
Compare the most important groups, with exact figures.
按时间顺序写出升降和转折点，带上数字。
Describe the rises, falls, and turning points in time order, with figures.

usageName.text: Describe the stages of a process

usageDescription.text: 流程图按步骤从头到尾写清。
For a process diagram, describe each stage from start to finish.
换一个角度或另一组数据再对比一次。
Compare again from another angle or with another set of data.
用一两句再点一次最主要的特征，不加看法。
Restate the main feature in one or two sentences, with no opinion.

description.text: 先改写题目并表明立场，再分段把理由写充分，可以让一步再反驳，最后重申立场。
Paraphrase the question and state your position, argue each reason in its own paragraph, concede and rebut if you like, and restate your position at the end.

usageName.text: Paraphrase the question and take a position

usageDescription.text: 用自己的话点出争议，并明确说出你的立场。
Restate the issue in your own words and state your position clearly.

usageName.text: Argue one reason with an example

usageDescription.text: 每段一个理由：先立论点，再解释，再举例。
One reason per paragraph: state it, explain it, then give an example.
承认对方有一点道理，再说明为什么你的立场更站得住。
Admit the other side has a point, then show why your position holds.
总结理由，用不同的话再说一次立场。
Sum up the reasons and restate your position in different words.

description.text: 先点出争议并说明要讨论双方看法，再分别写一方和另一方的理由，最后给出自己的判断。
Introduce the debate and say you will look at both sides, present one view then the other, and give your own judgement at the end.

usageDescription.text: 改写题目，说明有两种看法，并预告你的判断。
Restate the question, note that there are two views, and preview your judgement.
写清第一种看法为什么有人支持，给理由和例子。
Explain why people hold the first view, with reasons and examples.
用对比转到另一种看法，同样给理由和例子。
Turn to the other view by contrast, again with reasons and examples.
权衡双方后说出你更同意哪一边，为什么。
Weigh both sides and say which you agree with more, and why.

description.text: 先引入话题，再分别写好处和坏处，最后权衡后下判断。
Introduce the topic, write about the advantages and then the disadvantages, and weigh them up at the end.

usageName.text: 引入话题，点明要谈利弊

usageDescription.text: 改写题目，说明这件事既有好处也有坏处。
Restate the topic and note that it has both advantages and disadvantages.
写清好处，每一点带理由或例子。
Set out the advantages, each with a reason or example.
用对比转到坏处，同样带理由或例子。
Turn to the disadvantages by contrast, again with reasons or examples.
说出好处和坏处哪个更重，或在什么条件下才值得。
Say which side outweighs the other, or under what conditions it is worth it.

description.text: 先点出问题及其影响，再分析原因，然后提出办法，最后收住。
Present the problem and its effects, analyse the causes, propose solutions, and close.

usageDescription.text: 改写题目，说明问题是什么、有多严重。
Restate the task and say what the problem is and how serious it is.
写出一两个主要原因，带解释和例子。
Give one or two main causes, with explanation and examples.
针对原因给出办法，说明由谁做、怎么做。
Propose solutions that match the causes, and say who should do what.
总结办法，说出你对结果的判断。
Sum up the solutions and say what you expect to follow.

description.text: 题目问两个问题：先引入并预告两问，再一段答一问，最后收住。
The task asks two questions: introduce the topic, answer each question in its own paragraph, and close.

usageDescription.text: 改写题目，说明接下来要回答哪两个问题。
Restate the topic and say which two questions you will answer.
直接回答第一问，给理由和例子。
Answer the first question directly, with reasons and examples.
转到第二问，直接回答并支撑。
Turn to the second question, answer it directly, and support it.

usageName.text: 第二问要办法时给出办法
Give solutions if the second question asks for them

usageDescription.text: 第二问要办法时，给出办法和做法。
If the second question asks for solutions, give them and say how they work.
把两个回答收成一句结论。
Draw both answers together in one conclusion.

headDescription.text: 先写给谁，比如 Dear Tom 或 Dear Grandma。
Write who it is for, such as Dear Tom or Dear Grandma.

tailDescription.text: 最后写落款，比如 Love, 或 Yours,。
End with a sign-off, such as Love, or Yours,.

description.text: 先写你为什么写信，再写一句收尾。别忘了称呼和落款。
First say why you are writing, then add a short close. Remember the greeting and sign-off.

usageDescription.text: 题目里问什么就先答什么，再补一句相关细节。
Answer what the prompt asks first, then add one related detail.
先写你为什么写信、要说哪一件事。
First say why you are writing and what it is about.
用一句把信收住，比如谢谢或回见。
Close in one sentence, such as a thank-you or see you.

headDescription.text: 先写给谁，比如 Hi Mom 或 Dear Mr. Li。
Write who it is for, such as Hi Mom or Dear Mr. Li.

tailDescription.text: 最后写上你的名字和时间。
End with your name and the time.

description.text: 先说来意，再写清具体信息，最后提出请求或收尾。别忘了写给谁和署名。
Say why you are writing, give the details, and end with a request or a close. Remember who it is for and your name.

usageDescription.text: 题目里问什么就先答什么，再补一句相关细节。
Answer what the prompt asks first, then add one related detail.
先写你为什么写信、要说哪一件事。
First say why you are writing and what it is about.
写清时间、地点和要做的事。
Give the time, the place and what to do.
按先后顺序说清发生了什么。
Tell what happened in order.
用一句把信收住，比如谢谢或回见。
Close in one sentence, such as a thank-you or see you.
最后说清希望对方做什么。
End by saying what you would like the reader to do.

headDescription.text: 先写一行标题，比如 Notice 或活动名。
Write a one-line title, such as Notice or the event name.

tailDescription.text: 最后写谁发的，比如 Class 1 或 The School。
End with who sent it, such as Class 1 or The School.

description.text: 先说明这是什么通告，再写清时间和地点，可以加一句欢迎。
Say what the notice is about, give the time and place, and you may add a welcome.

usageDescription.text: 第一句说清要通知什么事。
Say in the first sentence what the notice is for.
写清什么时候、在哪里。
Say when and where.
最后加一句欢迎或提醒。
End with a welcome or a reminder.

headDescription.text: 先问好并自我介绍，比如 Hello, everyone. I'm Li Hua.
Greet the listeners and introduce yourself, such as Hello, everyone. I'm Li Hua.

tailDescription.text: 最后说 Thank you 或提出希望。
End with Thank you or a wish.

description.text: 先问好并说要讲什么，再讲一两点内容，最后致谢或提出希望。
Greet the listeners and say your topic, give one or two points, and end with thanks or a wish.

usageName.text: Say what you will talk about

usageDescription.text: 问好之后说清今天要讲的事。
After the greeting, say what you will talk about today.
一开始就说出你的看法。
State your point right at the start.
把一点内容讲清楚，加一句细节。
Make one point clear and add a detail.
按顺序讲一件相关的事。
Tell one related thing in order.

usageName.text: Give a reason and an example

usageDescription.text: 先说为什么，再举一个例子。
Give the reason first, then one example.
用一句把发言收住。
Close the talk in one sentence.

usageName.text: End with a wish or a call

usageDescription.text: 最后说出你的希望或号召大家做什么。
End with your wish or what you want everyone to do.

headDescription.text: 先写一行标题，概括这件事。
Write a one-line headline that sums up the event.

description.text: 先写导语说清何时何地发生了什么，再写经过，最后写结果或评价。
Start with a lead giving when, where and what happened, then the details, and end with the result or a comment.

usageDescription.text: 第一段一句话说清时间、地点和发生了什么。
In one sentence give the time, the place and what happened.
按先后顺序写清经过。
Tell what happened in order.
补充人物、数字等关键细节。
Add key details such as people and numbers.
最后说清结果如何。
End with how it turned out.
最后加一句大家的评价或感受。
End with one comment or feeling from people.

headDescription.text: 先写一行标题，再写称呼，比如 Dear friends,
Write a one-line title, then a greeting such as Dear friends,

tailDescription.text: 最后写倡议人和日期。
End with who proposes it and the date.

description.text: 先说明背景和问题，再讲清为什么以及怎么做，最后发出呼吁。
State the background and the problem, explain why and what to do, and end with a call to action.

usageDescription.text: 先说清是什么情况、为什么要写这份倡议。
Say what the situation is and why you are writing this proposal.
一开始就点出要解决的问题。
Name the problem to solve right at the start.
说清为什么要这样做，并举例。
Explain why it matters and give an example.
针对问题提出具体做法。
Give concrete steps for the problem.
说清你的立场和理由。
State your stand and the reason.
最后号召大家一起行动。
End by calling everyone to act together.
